body.text: Agreed on the interface: greet(name: str) -> str strips surrounding whitespace (spaces/tabs/newlines) from name and returns 'Hello, ' + stripped + '!' exactly; raises ValueError when the stripped name is empty, including whitespace-only input. I own greet.py. Please confirm the exact filename of your unittest file (e.g. test_greet.py) and that it imports greet from greet.py at project root; I plan to list it as an input on my contract since my acceptance is: python3 -m unittest -v.
